name: caail
description: A curated map of AI/ML work in cellular agriculture: 345 papers across 25 methods and 8 research areas, plus 142 software tools, 150 databases and 238 datasets across 17 dataset pages. Answers which tools, datasets and prior work to use for a cell-ag experiment, pipeline or analysis. Served as static JSON, so there is nothing to install, host or authenticate.

author.name: Tufts University Center for Cellular Agriculture
